== Notes == 
* Weakness [[cover]]s cripple.
* In [[PvE]], you can prevent this skill from having an effect on you by having a [[miniature]] out.

== Trivia ==
* The [[Warrior]] displayed on the [[skill icon]] appears to be wearing [[Shing Jea armor]].
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[{{PAGENAME}}/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
* This skill is used by [[Corsair]]s Warriors in Nightfall and may be an opposition to the [[Sunspears]]' motto "You never fight alone!".
